note: Example numbers only. A made-up strength program for new fathers, invented for the walk. Nothing here is a real person or business.

answers.offerNow: Online strength coaching for busy people, sold by the month.
answers.marketWho: Men in their thirties who used to train

painQuotes.quote: I have not slept properly in eight months and I am too tired to train.
I can barely lift the car seat without my back going.
Every plan I try assumes I have an hour and a gym.

nicheLadder.niche: Anyone who wants to get strong

answers.nicheChosen: New fathers in the first year, training at home with no gym

channels.where: Two online groups for new dads

answers.outcomeWorthWhy: A private trainer twice a week is about $400 a month; a bad back cost one of them $1,800 in physio last year; the sleep and energy are worth more than either to them.
answers.dreamOutcome: Strong enough to carry the baby, the bags and the stroller up the stairs without thinking about it, and to have energy left at the end of the day.
answers.dreamStatus: the dad who keeps up, not the one who is always tired

answers.guaranteeText: Do the three sessions a week for six weeks and log your carry test. If it has not gone up by twenty pounds, I keep coaching you for free until it does.
answers.guaranteeCondition: does three sessions a week and logs the carry test
answers.oneLine: New fathers in their first year get strong enough to carry the baby, the bags and the stroller up the stairs without thinking about it, in six weeks, twenty minutes at a time, without a gym, or I keep coaching them for free until they do.
